name: Diaring
text: Diaring is a variant spelling of the name Diorruing. The dictionary lists Diaring as a spelling only. It sends readers onward to the Diorruing entry. Diorruing is the Fenian attendant of Fionn mac Cumhaill. He is the clairvoyant among Fionn's retinue. Diaring is the older or alternate form of the same name. Scholars treat Diaring and Diorruing as the same figure. The Diaring form appears chiefly in early manuscripts. The Diorruing form is the standard modern spelling. Either form names the same attendant in the Fenian Cycle. See the Diorruing entry for the full record.
